meta.name: developer-frontend
meta.description: Frontend development standards — UI/UX principles, accessibility, state management, and component patterns. Load when writing frontend code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 遵循前端开发标准编写UI代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在写前端代码时需要参考UI/UX、可访问性和组件模式标准。
copy.tagline_en: Write UI code following frontend development standards
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need UI/UX, accessibility, and component pattern standards while writing frontend code.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照前端开发标准编写代码，包括无障碍、性能优化、状态管理、组件设计等，并自动加载相关语言技能。
howto.when: 当你编写前端代码时，Claude 会自动加载此技能，并可能根据代码语言加载对应的语言技能。

say.text: 帮我写一个符合 WCAG 2.1 AA 标准的按钮组件。
say.note: Claude 会生成无障碍友好的按钮代码。

say.text: 优化这个页面的加载性能，包括懒加载和代码分割。
say.note: Claude 会应用性能优化规则。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will follow frontend development standards for accessibility, performance, state management, and component patterns, and automatically load relevant language skills.
howto.when_en: When you write frontend code, Claude will automatically load this skill and may load language-specific skills based on the code language.

say_en.text: Write a button component that meets WCAG 2.1 AA standards.
say_en.note: Claude will generate accessible button code.

say_en.text: Optimize this page's loading performance with lazy loading and code splitting.
say_en.note: Claude will apply performance optimization rules.
